|lore='''Leader'''. Secretive manipulator of the galaxy. Played Darth Vader and Prince Xizor off against one another in his relentless pursuit of “young Skywalker.”
|game_text=May not deploy or move to a site opponent occupies (except the Senate). Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to target character present at same site (free, if in a battle): character is defense value -4 until end of turn. OR Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value, character lost. At opponent's senate, politics = 4 and game text may not be canceled.

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The January restriction uses “never,” which the period rules apply even when game text is canceled. October #46a reorders the verbs and keeps the same restriction. The remaster expressly includes being carried, removes the defense-value alternative and Senate cancellation protection, prints Politics 4 as a stat and grants a Republic icon at the opponent’s Senate. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=20 Period never restrictions].
